title: DeepSeek Pauses Funding Round After Leak
summary: DeepSeek has verbally informed some second-round investors to pause signing investment agreements, partly due to founder Liang Wenfeng&\#x27;s displeasure over leaked internal discussions online. This pause signals potential governance challenges at a leading Chinese AI startup and could affect investor confidence and the pace of AI funding in China. DeepSeek completed a $7 billion first round in June 2026 and was planning a second round of at least 10 billion yuan with a pre-money valuation of no less than 480 billion yuan.
context: DeepSeek, founded in July 2023 by Liang Wenfeng, is a Chinese AI company known for developing cost-effective large language models like DeepSeek-R1. It is backed by High-Flyer and has attracted investors including Tencent, CATL, and the National AI Industry Investment Fund. The company&\#x27;s success has been described as &\#x27;upending AI&\#x27; due to its open-weight models and low training costs.
